statements.quote: Our generative AI book of business now stands at more than $5 billion inception-to-date, up nearly $2 billion quarter over quarter," said Arvind Krishna, IBM chairman, president and chief executive officer.
statements.notes: 'more than $5 billion' recorded as the $5 billion floor. 'Book of business' is cumulative inception-to-date bookings/signings (software sales plus consulting signings), not recognized revenue for fiscal 2024, so it is not a fiscal-year AI revenue figure; recorded only because it is the sole quantified AI demand statement. The quarter-over-quarter increase of nearly $2 billion is also a book-of-business figure, not revenue.
